notes.title: RenXia Demo Update (20241206)
notes.content:
Due to the difficulty of the current game, many players who are not good at action games can not get started at all.
Therefore, we made a slight adjustment to reduce the difficulty, as follows:
1. Increase perfect dodge judgment time and slightly reduce difficulty
2. Increase the front shake time of Brother's three and four strikes to reduce the difficulty
3. Increase the judgment time of countermeasures and slightly reduce the difficulty
4. Increases the protagonist's execution of enemies to damage Ren Xia

notes.title: RenXia Demo version BUG fix update 01
notes.content:
1 Added a text message indicating that the maximum value of the flaw cannot be stored in the teaching level, and automatically reset the flaw value
2 Added that when a battle occurs in a small courtyard, some interactive objects will be automatically hidden, making the battle site cleaner.

notes.title: Ren Xia Demo BUG Fix 02 (20241204)
notes.content:
BUG fixes:
1. The power storage button fails

New features:
1. You can skip the prologue when starting the game

notes.title: Demo version emergency fix update
notes.content:
1. Modify the game running icon
2. Adjust the Master's perfect four combo, the speed is changed to 0.9, and the hit stiffness time per attack is changed from 0.7 seconds to 0.5 seconds, hoping that the player can cope with it more easily.
3. Adjust the post-shake time of the elder brother's counterattack, so that the start of his follow-up counterattack combo is slower and easier for the player to deal with
4. Fix the BUG that players can attack when they accumulate power
5. Optimized the problem of voice captions being too fast after the victory of senior teachers in teaching Guanzhong
6. Added a description of the cost of damage for power attacks in the teaching level
7. Change the completion condition of blue attack to perfect defense 2 times and countermeasure 1 time. Perfect attack response complete condition changed to Perfect Defense 4 times and perfect Dodge 1 time. Make it easier for players to pass the teaching level.
8. Brothers sweep legs slower, easier to deal with

Finally, have a good time! The game is hard, but don't give up!
